images.prompt: Natural coastal photograph looking straight down one narrow wooden pier toward one small white hut with a dark pitched roof. Low railings run along both sides, calm pale blue water surrounds the pier, and a flat distant horizon sits behind the hut. Soft morning light, centered composition, full hut visible, empty scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Complete composition with breathing room. Natural photography and realistic light; no text, logo, watermark, or existing graphic treatment.

review.reason: One fully framed white hut with a pitched roof, one central door and two windows stands at the end of a continuous wooden pier. Rails connect to its platform, and the calm water and distant horizon have natural perspective. No people, duplicate building, lettering, watermark or existing polar distortion appears.

images.actual_source_analysis: One narrow wooden pier extends from the lower frame toward a single small white hut centered above it. Two continuous railings border the walkway and join a small platform beside the hut. The hut has one central glazed door, one window on each side, and one dark pitched roof with a single apex. Its whole roof and facade are visible. Pale blue calm water lies on both sides of the pier; a flat distant shoreline runs behind the lower part of the hut. A broad blue sky with sparse clouds fills the upper frame. Morning light is warmer on the right railing, with soft plank shadows on the walkway.
